acceptance: For each listed adapter: a test shows force_recreate either recreates at the first connection or produces a clear user-visible message that it cannot.
The contract test's exemption list no longer names these adapters, or each remaining exemption states the decision.
context: Source: independent review and author report of PR #2632 (2026-10-04).
description:
## Problem (observed by reading code and running fakes in the mid-run contract test)
At the first connection these adapters do not act on `force_recreate`: Velox defines no existence probe; InfluxDB only logs a warning; Firebolt Core's `drop_database` only logs; Snowpark Connect accepts the option but never acts; MotherDuck's adapter does not read it. A user passing `--force-recreate` gets a silent no-op.

## Change
Per adapter, decide and implement one of: act on it, or reject/warn loudly that the platform cannot recreate. Record the decision in the contract test's exemption reason so the exemption is explicit.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No live cloud runs without explicit approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
